id: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (2004)

new.note: Butterscotch cream soda under a thick cream foam, served in tankards.
new.how: Whip the cream with the icing sugar to soft, floppy peaks. Stir a tablespoon of butterscotch sauce into each tankard and pour in the cold cream soda. Spoon the cream foam on top and serve straight away.

r2.make_ahead: Whip the cream up to 2 hours ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Whip the cream with the icing sugar to soft, floppy peaks.
Stir a tablespoon of butterscotch sauce into each tankard and pour in the cold cream soda.
Spoon the cream foam on top and serve straight away.

new.note: Lamb cooked down hard with tomato, ginger and green chilli in the karahi, warm naan to scoop.
new.how: Brown the lamb in the oil in a wide pan. Add the garlic, ginger and spices and stir for a minute. Add the tomatoes and a splash of water, cover and simmer until the lamb is tender. Uncover, add the chillies and cook hard, stirring, until the sauce clings to the meat. Season. Warm the naan and scatter the karahi with coriander.

r2.make_ahead: Make up to 2 days ahead; it is better the next day

steps.text: Brown the lamb in the oil in a wide pan.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and stir for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and a splash of water, cover and simmer until the lamb is tender.
Uncover, add the chillies and cook hard, stirring, until the sauce clings to the meat. Season.
Warm the naan and scatter the karahi with coriander.

new.veg: Swap the lamb for paneer and chickpeas, added for the last 10 minutes.

id: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny (2023)

new.note: Fresh blood orange juice topped with soda water over ice, a wheel of orange on top.
new.how: Juice 5 oranges and stir with the sugar until it dissolves. Pour over ice, top with soda water and add a wheel of the last orange.

r2.make_ahead: Juice up to 4 hours ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Juice 5 oranges and stir with the sugar until it dissolves.
Pour over ice, top with soda water and add a wheel of the last orange.
